title: hoshidicts aii test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Assyrian Neo-Aramaic dictionary for languages/aii/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. Most rows carry the pack's part-of-speech tags; rows with an empty rules column stand for wty-aii-en, whose rows are all untagged, and match every condition under the pack's lookup.untaggedTerms "pass"; ܐܡܐܐ (num) and ܒܒܠ (name) carry only tags the pack does not know. ܒܵܬܹ̈ܐ is a form-of row, as wiktionary-to-yomitan writes them.
